answer: Capture-recapture census: each epoch two independent detectors, one tracing funding lineage and one clustering response timing, flag suspected clones. On every island of the trust graph, Lincoln-Petersen math on their overlap estimates how many sybils both missed, and that island's emission is cut by the estimated hidden share and held behind a slow jetty until audits clear it. A ring cannot crack this walnut by dodging one detector: being caught by only one shrinks the overlap and inflates the hidden-clone estimate.
